items.source_name: Nation Press (plus The Telegraph IG reel)
items.summary: Rahul Gandhi's 4:00 PM IST high-tea meeting of INDIA-bloc MPs, civil society and student groups at his 5 Sunehri Bagh Road residence went ahead on Tuesday, Oct 13 - the first post-tea reporting. A verified Telegraph reel shows Sonia Gandhi arriving at the residence. Per Nation Press: Congress MP Karti Chidambaram reiterated the demand for EC reformation and CEC Gyanesh Kumar's resignation; SP MP Awadhesh Prasad said democracy and the Constitution are under threat; Abhishek Manu Singhvi said the campaign reflects people's love and anger; Shashi Tharoor declined to comment ahead of the meeting. Congress MP Deepender Hooda pushed back on the barricade-breach allegations from Monday's march, saying Rahul Gandhi personally stopped the convoy when barricades fell - a rebuttal of official accounts that underpin the four BNSS Section 163 FIRs. A joint press conference of INDIA leaders was reportedly planned for the evening.
items.title: High tea held at Rahul Gandhi's residence; Sonia Gandhi attended; MPs reiterate CEC-resignation demand, Hooda rebuts barricade-row

items.summary: First reporting of an INDIA-alliance press conference on Tuesday, Oct 13 (Times Now Navbharat carousel, posted 13:04:02Z). Rahul Gandhi alleged that Amit Shah, PM Modi and CEC Gyanesh Kumar are the planners of 'vote theft', thanked the public for backing the fight for democracy, and said future steps will be kept as surprises. Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge said the opposition wants to expose PM Modi's vote-theft plan; RJD's Tejashwi Yadav said the opposition is united to save democracy and accused the government of trying to hijack constitutional institutions; AISA president Neha Bora said the BJP is the only enemy of India's democracy and that protests will not stop. A SabkiKhabar reel partially corroborates a post-meeting press interaction at Rahul Gandhi's residence with Kharge and Tejashwi Yadav addressing the media.
items.title: Post-tea INDIA bloc press conference: Rahul Gandhi calls Modi, Shah and Gyanesh Kumar 'planners of vote theft', vows surprises
